description: Each small square represents one basic operation. A surrounding loop box marks the part that repeats.

frames.explanation: A box inside another box indicates nesting. For every outer iteration, the inner loop runs a full n times. Multiply the counts to get n × n. Two loops run one after the other would have their counts added instead.
